claims.source_quote_ar: قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: (وَهُوَ اللَّهُ) : وَهُوَ مُبْتَدَأٌ، وَاللَّهُ الْخَبَرُ.
claims.claim_ar: «وَهُوَ» هنا مبتدأ (مبتدأ ضمير يُشير إلى الاسم التالي).
claims.claim_en: The pronoun 'wa-huwa' here functions as a mubtada (subject pronoun that points to the following noun).
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted passage exemplifies the construction with «وَهُوَ اللَّهُ» and is being applied analogically to «وَهُوَ الْقَاهِرُ» in this ayah; verify the author discusses this exact verse.
